blockers.description: WhisperX subprocess (uv-managed Python 3.9 env at model_cache/.cache/uv/archive-v0/W3y4UNFsdQ-iUM58E_oZE) calls torch.load on pyannote VAD model with weights_only=True. Fails with: UnpicklingError: Unsupported global GLOBAL omegaconf.listconfig.ListConfig. The existing 01-04 patch only skipped --align_model; VAD is loaded unconditionally inside whisperx regardless of alignment args.
blockers.workaround: Three candidate fixes: (1) pass --vad_method silero to whisperx if supported by installed version; (2) inject sitecustomize.py into the uv env that calls torch.serialization.add_safe_globals([omegaconf.listconfig.ListConfig]) before whisperx imports torch; (3) pre-warm pyannote VAD in our venv with weights_only=False, then point whisperx at cached model. Option 1 is cleanest if whisperx supports --vad_method.

decisions.decision: Override device config in TribeModel.from_pretrained via config_update dict targeting data.text_feature.device, data.image_feature.image.device, data.audio_feature.device, data.video_feature.image.device
decisions.rationale: Pretrained config.yaml hardcodes device: cuda on all four extractors; without override, video extractor crashes with 'Torch not compiled with CUDA enabled' during prepare(). This is cleaner than patching cached config.yaml.

decisions.decision: Add _to_numpy helper in inference.py instead of .cpu().numpy()
decisions.rationale: TribeModel.predict() returns a numpy array directly, not a torch tensor, so the previous .cpu().numpy() crashed with AttributeError. Helper handles both cases.
Local IDE/tool state should not go to public repo.

next_action: Investigate whisperx CLI support for --vad_method silero in the version used by the uv env. If supported, patch tribev2/tribev2/eventstransforms.py to pass --vad_method silero on CPU path. If not supported, fall back to injecting a sitecustomize.py into the uv archive env that registers omegaconf.listconfig.ListConfig as a safe global before torch.load runs.
context_notes: Video pathway is now proven end-to-end on CPU (~17min per run, shape (n, >10000) confirmed). That alone satisfies ROADMAP SC #1. The text pathway is stuck at the WhisperX VAD layer — note that the text pipeline goes text → TTS audio → WhisperX ASR+VAD → word events → Llama-3.2-3B features, so WhisperX is a hard prerequisite even though it's not the 'main' text model. The uv sub-env is bootstrapped once and reused across runs — fixes to that env persist across test invocations. Commit fd3fcc0 pushed to https://github.com/iamakashazad/brainx main.
